verdict.rationale: Yapily documents its own Payments API for initiating single, scheduled and periodic bank-to-bank payments from a customer's account. It adds SCA and redirect handling and webhook status tracking. Live geographies are only implied by naming the local rails (Faster Payments in the UK, SEPA in Europe), with no explicit country or bank coverage list. missing for 10: an explicit, honest statement of live countries and institution coverage for payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live payment initiation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly

citations.quote: You can initiate single, scheduled and periodic payments using Yapily's Payments API.
Initiate bank-to-bank payments directly from your customer's account.
Payments are made via local payment rails including Faster Payments in the UK and SEPA in Europe for fast settlement
You can track the status of each payment via [Webhooks](/tools-and-services/webhooks/get-started) from the Yapily API for visibility of the payment initiation success.
